# Settings

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_settings_doc.py from src/baritone/Settings.h. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every setting has the same name, default value and meaning as in [Baritone's Settings.java](https://github.com/cabaletta/baritone/blob/master/src/api/java/baritone/api/Settings.java), so guides written for Baritone apply here. Differences that come from Bedrock are listed in [PARITY.md](PARITY.md).

Usage in the chat:

```
#set <name> <value>     change a setting (#set allowBreak false)
#set <name>             show a setting; a boolean is toggled
#set reset <name|all>   back to the default
#modified               list the settings you changed
```

Lists are written comma-separated (`#set blocksToAvoid minecraft:magma,minecraft:cactus`), colors as `r,g,b`. Changed settings are saved to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\BaritoneBedrock\settings.txt` and loaded again on the next injection.

251 settings.
